tips_en: Start with Paper 1 (HC-DLM) as it introduces the most foundational framework—a principled hierarchical coupling between continuous latent states and discrete tokens—which conceptually underpins the latent-grounding challenges explored in Paper 2 (ReaLVR), where latent visual reasoning tokens similarly struggle to stay anchored to observable evidence. Papers 1 and 2 share a deep thematic connection: both address how persistent latent trajectories can be made faithful to their discrete readouts, whether text tokens or visual evidence. Paper 3 (World Observer) is more applied and can be read later, though it echoes the same latent–observable coupling problem in the video-generation domain via its panoramic observer design.
tips_zh: 建议先读论文1（HC-DLM），因为它提出了最基础的理论框架——连续潜在状态与离散token之间原则性的分层耦合机制，这为理解论文2（ReaLVR）中潜在视觉推理token如何锚定于视觉证据的挑战提供了概念基础。论文1和论文2有深刻的主题联系：两者都关注如何让持续的潜在轨迹忠实于其离散读出，无论是文本token还是视觉证据。论文3（World Observer）更偏向应用，可以稍后阅读，但它通过全景观察者的设计在视频生成领域呼应了同样的潜在-观测耦合问题。
